name: Art
description: Create and edit images or generate short videos with Cindy's media capabilities. You can also invoke it directly with $cindy-art.
whenToUse: Use this plugin to create or edit images, illustrations, avatars, posters, and other artwork, or to generate short videos and animate still images. Prefer Art when the user has not explicitly selected another media-generation channel.

gen_image.description: Prepare text-to-image parameters. Unless the user names a model, use the exact modelId/providerId configured by Host on the plugin page; do not replace a subscription-only model merely because it is absent from the public catalog. Returns request.modelId/request.providerId; pass both unchanged to Core prepare as model_id/provider_id.

edit_image.description: Prepare parameters to edit or combine up to four images. Unless the user names a model, use the exact modelId/providerId configured by Host on the plugin page; do not replace a subscription-only model merely because it is absent from the public catalog. Returns request.modelId/request.providerId; pass both unchanged to Core prepare as model_id/provider_id.

gen_video.description: Prepare text-to-video parameters. Unless the user names a model, use the exact modelId/providerId configured by Host on the plugin page; do not replace a subscription-only model merely because it is absent from the public catalog. Returns request.modelId/request.providerId; pass both unchanged to Core prepare as model_id/provider_id.

edit_video.description: Prepare image-to-video parameters: one image is the first frame; two are the first and last frames. Unless the user names a model, use the exact modelId/providerId configured by Host on the plugin page; do not replace a subscription-only model merely because it is absent from the public catalog. Returns request.modelId/request.providerId; pass both unchanged to Core prepare as model_id/provider_id.
